snippet.title: All 6 Stadiums in Go Long! (Lava Included)
snippet.description:
From Sunny Park to the Moon to an actual volcano: every stadium, each with its own music and hazards.

👉 Wishlist Go Long! on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5356650/

Go Long! is a goofy, floppy 3v3 catching sport. Throw Long Bombs, dive for trick catches, mess with rivals using powers in six wild stadiums, then pelt a giant boss at halftime. Coming soon to Steam.

Chapters:
0:00 Sunny Park
0:16 Maple Street
0:30 Pirate Cove
0:49 The Moon
1:05 Mount Kaboom
1:22 Castle Crumbleton
